claim: Depth-Trajectory Spectral Fusion may improve optical-SAR dense segmentation by exposing a fixed depth-coordinate trajectory of the CROMA SAR stream.
hypothesis: A fixed Hadamard transform over late SAR depth taps with an innovation-only zero-start low-rank readout yields useful trajectory coordinates under the matched CROMA/SEN12TS protocol.
experiment: Full-horizon seed-0 DTSF-01 validation on the fixed SEN12TS train/validation split for 24 epochs.
falsification_criterion: Best full-horizon validation mIoU gain below +1.0pp closes the depth-trajectory family; controls remain locked.

effect_evidence.basis: best validation checkpoint epoch 20 versus verified R2 best-validation comparator; full 24-epoch train/validation-only run

prior_art_assessment.nearest_prior_art: VAT representation trajectory; FDMF-Net and FreDNet frequency/cross-stage fusion; DCTransformer and MDNet DCT-based remote-sensing feature extraction; CROMA multimodal EO VFM.
prior_art_assessment.new_axis: Fixed orthonormal coordinate transform over the four audited late CROMA SAR depth taps, followed by innovation-only zero-start rank-8 readout into the existing late SAR token.
prior_art_assessment.novelty_claim_boundary: Do not claim trajectory, DCT/Hadamard, frequency fusion, cross-stage fusion, low-rank residuals or CROMA as new; claim only the bounded late SAR depth-coordinate operation under the matched EO VFM segmentation protocol if it survives the preregistered effect gate.
prior_art_assessment.what_is_not_new: Representation trajectories, fixed spectral bases, frequency-aware fusion, cross-stage fusion, low-rank residual adapters and CROMA pretraining.

notes: Best mIoU=50.4047002%, +0.6239123pp over verified R2 comparator 49.7807879%; formal endpoint=-0.4241605pp. Predeclared <+1pp rule rejects and closes the route. Test sealed.
